note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article 'Stryker'. The article is a secondary compilation, so every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. It holds the M1126 Stryker infantry carrier vehicle (ICV) as a wheeled entry. It publishes identity, the ICV mass, the overall length, width and height, the engine model, the engine rating of 350 hp with no net basis, the maximum road speed and the operational range. It publishes no ground clearance figure (the article mentions a high ground clearance in prose only), no tyre size code, no tyre width or tyre diameter, no transmission and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready. No stronger source is held: the public US Army operator manual for the M1126 is not on the two manual mirrors that served the other captures, and the maker site is bot-walled.
